summary: NETCONF-enabled platforms use XML over SSH via ansible.netcommon.netconf for all modules except junos_netconf, with SSH keys or -u/-k via bastion; connection local is deprecated.
questions: How do I connect to a generic NETCONF device with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Generic NETCONF connection options
answer_card.answer_md:
- Protocol: XML over SSH
- Modules: all except `junos_netconf` (which enables NETCONF)
- Credentials: SSH keys/agent or `-u myuser -k`
- Indirect access: bastion/jump host
- `ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.netconf` (`local` is deprecated)
